October update: confirmed data findings

Checked 21 October 2026 against patch 165921. These are companion-site findings from recovered configuration data, separate from official patch notes.

What has been checked

Useful patch data; live identity unverified. Patch 165921 contains the additions below. Its exact relationship to the live server payload has not been established. Unchanged website datasets are not automatically verified for this patch.

The stats calculator and My Tatari now support recorded account levels 1–3,600. The Horde / Goldrush calculator remains a fixed level-500 comparison. Existing values through level 2,400 match the previous export exactly.

Bonobean and account levels

Bonobean (UnitID 68), Titanape, Grangutan and Primakong are now integrated across My Tatari, the database, stats calculator, evolution planner, Horde guide/drafter and tierlist tools. Normal and Glitter portraits use the supplied images. Food levels 0–16, evolution trials and source-resolved regular/Horde skills are included.

ItemFinding
Account-level tableExtended from 2,400 to 3,600
Existing levels 1–2,400No change in exported element steps or stat standards
Calculator formulasExisting formulas retained; new levels use recorded tables, not extrapolation
Bonobean integrationAll four forms, normal/Glitter artwork, account saves, stats, trials and drafting tools

Horde Season 3 configuration

The S3 configuration maps to parameter set 103 and lists Difficulties 1–6. Difficulty 6 uses DefenseID 10306. The older S3 configuration listed only Difficulties 1–4.

Season 3 waves, chip values and existing Tatari skill cards are now integrated. The six difficulty settings retain a rank coefficient of 100 and reference the same balance and energy-recovery settings as S2.

Collectible additions

Original and color accessory variants are present for Zapup, Sparkit, Pandaroo, Cheerling, Lullely, Funglet, Taptail, Budboo, Cavyzap, Ringtail and Popa.

The records confirm additions, not their availability on a particular account or release date. Cosmetic records are separate from saved Glitter ownership.

Halloween and battle setup

Trick-or-Treat reward configuration and the strings “Trick-or-Treat Time!” and “Halloween Fun!” are present. The event dates and exact replacement schedule are not established, so the site calendar has not been rescheduled from this evidence alone.

The patch contains 429 new and 404 changed StageBattle files. These counts describe files, not player-facing changes. Their chapter mapping is still under review; formation recommendations have not been recalibrated from the counts alone.

Confirmed chip updates

The 49 chip catalogue entries, qualities, uniqueness and allowed-wave lists are unchanged. Four numeric changes occur in linked Skill records; comparing LuckyDefenseChip alone misses them.

ChipPrevious valuePatch 165921
AFK300 energizers400 energizers; still 40 seconds
First-Aid Kit15% lost HP12% lost HP; still every 4 seconds on the first two rows
Lawn Care40% Max HP percentage damage35%; mower count and initial non-boss kills unchanged
Mission Reset200 energizers per recalled Tatari180 energizers
Backend SupportOne Tatari in frontExplicitly one of your own Tatari; still 45% damage boost

Shuffle still grants 600 energizers. Contract Employees stay deployed, and their Tatari types are now excluded from the replacement pool. Ordinary replacement units inherit the replaced slots’ grid positions and Horde levels. Candidate selection and historical-level bookkeeping were rewritten. This does not guarantee that all replacements differ from your previous ordinary Tatari types; unusual edge cases have not been tested in a live battle.

Other Horde mechanics and limits

  • All eight deployment/upgrade costs, death refunds, rank stat multipliers and skill unlock indexes are unchanged.
  • Energy recovery is unchanged: start at 400, initially gain 25 every 5 seconds, decrease the periodic gain by 5 every 90 seconds, and gain 4 per normal kill or 100 per boss kill.
  • The rank, season-rank and wave reward tables and the balance table are unchanged.
  • Horde’s configured level reference remains 500. Normal account-level inputs and Supabase saves accept 1–3,600.
  • New parameters 39=200 and 40=5 remain unmapped. The official override differs from the default parameter table; its selection is not established.

86 existing Horde detail entries changed, but many edits only correct labels, formatting, historical comparison values or buff/nerf arrows. Those display edits must not be counted as additional combat changes. Bonobean’s new active skill illustrates why this matters: current minimum/maximum interval fields are 22/26 seconds, while its comparison metadata lists 12/16.

Still unverified

  • Goldrush weekly giftbox limit
  • Boss Challenge merge changes
  • Halloween event dates and replacement timing
  • Exact match to the live server payload
  • Meaning and consumer binding of new Horde parameters 39 (200) and 40 (5)
  • Selection of the official Horde parameter override and unusual Shuffle edge cases

Evidence: recovered Unit, Pet, ProfilePicture, UnitLevel, UnitAttrLevel, LuckyDefenseSeasonConfig, LuckyDefenseConfig and PetCollectible records, plus decoded English language data. Raw game code and packages are kept offline.
